'''Indona''', also known as the '''Indona forests''',<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020712bbeasts&c=rpg|series=Creature Feature|text=Battle Arena Beasts}} </ref> was a continent in the northern latitudes of<ref name="Insider63" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Beyond">''[[Beyond the Rim]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]].<ref name="Insider63" /> The continent featured [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]]<ref name="Core" /> and [[Temperature/Legends|chilly]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]] that covered it. A four-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] breed of the predatory [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] creature, that was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Cholganna, originated in Indona<ref name="Insider63" /> and had adapted to the cool forest environment of the planet.<ref name="DB">{{DB|creature|nexu|nexu}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Indona was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook|revised core rulebook]] to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'',<ref name="Core" /> published in [[May]] [[2002]]<ref name="Date">{{Wizards|url=starwars/product.asp?17650|text=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Rulebook}}</ref> by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="Core" /> The continent was first identified as "Indona forests" in a "[[Creature Feature]]" web supplement to the roleplaying game on [[July 12]], 2002.<ref name="Wizards" /> Indona was misspelled and mislabeled as "Idona Forest" in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', a [[2013]] adventure for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] produced by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Beyond" />
